mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which tends to boost equity markets by reducing borrowing costs and increasing risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative more than 50% of the time when FEDFUNDS is below 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate suggests economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as consumer and business confidence declines.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by >0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive more than 40% of the time when UNRATE increases by >0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) is strong but housing starts (HOUST) are declining, it indicates an imbalance in economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as housing is a key component of the economy.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time when GDPC1 growth >2% and HOUST <1.2 million.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests supply chain issues or reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings may be impacted.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive more than 40% of the time when INDPRO <95.

mechanism_narrative: Consistent growth in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns as consumer spending and business investment increase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative more than 30% of the time when PAYEMS growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates inflationary pressures, which may lead to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns as interest rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive more than 40% of the time when CPIAUCSL >200.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as earnings in consumer discretionary and retail sectors may decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive more than 40% of the time when RSAFS <300 billion.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL) and low unemployment (UNRATE) may lead to wage inflation and higher interest rates, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time when CPIAUCSL >200 and UNRATE <5%.
